meta.scope: Scheduled reference snapshot around configured seed areas only; not a complete global POI feed.

proximity_policy.note: A 10-15 km map radius is for exploration and must not be treated as nearby-tourism evidence.

OpenStreetMap.license: ODbL 1.0; attribution required; share-alike obligations may apply

OpenTripMap.message: Set GitHub Actions secret OPENTRIPMAP_API_KEY to enable this source.

Wikivoyage.license: Wikivoyage content CC BY-SA; only title/coordinate metadata stored

Open Food Facts.note: Product catalogue only; not sales volume, price history or market share.

World Bank Tourism Indicators.note: Country-level annual context; not visitor counts for a particular attraction.

UN Tourism Statistics Database.method: Official database/publication access; no unauthenticated public API configured
UN Tourism Statistics Database.note: The official page states that free database access for students/researchers requires a formal written request. Do not scrape the portal or label country statistics as site-level visitor counts.

limitations: Mapped places are leads, not verified businesses, active attractions, stock or buyers.
The current device/location is not sent to this collector. Dynamic nearby detection uses a separate on-demand query.
OpenTripMap and OpenStreetMap datasets carry attribution/licensing obligations.
